استقربوا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْرَبُوا (istaqrabū) /is.taq.ra.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
# اُسْتُقْرِبُوا (ustuqribū) /us.tuq.ri.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
# اِسْتَقْرِبُوا (istaqribū) /is.taq.ri.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
